name: Entitledto
tagline: Free online benefits calculator helping UK citizens understand welfare entitlements
last_funding_event: Ongoing government funding from Department for Work and Pensions
dependency_risks: Reliance on UK government welfare policy data accuracy
Changes to benefits legislation require platform updates

policy_outcomes.description: Entitledto's benefits calculator has been integrated into UK government welfare guidance and is recommended by the Department for Work and Pensions as an official resource for citizens to check benefit eligibility

news_articles.headline: Free online tool helps people claim benefits they are entitled to

documented_limitations: Requires accurate user input for accurate calculations
failure_modes: Outdated benefits information due to policy changes
User input errors leading to incorrect benefit calculations
curation_criteria: Automated calculation based on UK Department for Work and Pensions benefit eligibility rules and thresholds
contributor_governance: Managed by parent organization; limited public contribution model due to proprietary nature
political_relevance_summary: Entitledto addresses civic data access and transparency. Free online benefits calculator helping UK citizens understand welfare entitlements.
generalizability_notes: Could be adapted to other national contexts with localization. Proprietary or closed-source; replication requires licensing.
